description: Korea Airports Corporation (KAC) publishes aviation statistics and open data. The statistics pages give monthly figures from 2006 by airport, route, time of day, day of week, airline and aircraft type, with transfer passengers, delays and cancellations, published about five working days after each month. A list of open files in CSV covers airport facilities and runways, aprons and parking, runway pavement strength, obstacles, fire and rescue capacity, processing times, noise zones, schedules, passenger, flight and cargo results, delays and cancellations, and navigation aid safety assessments. Open APIs in XML give flight operations (airline, flight number, scheduled and changed times, gate), transport statistics, noise and greenhouse gas data, with applications made through the national public data portal. Coverage is national, with statistics for Gimpo, Gimhae, Jeju, Incheon and the other airports listed. Access is free: pages and files to download without login, and APIs after a free application; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: many files were registered in 2014 to 2016 and may not be current. The data support airport capacity planning, delay and disruption analysis and emergency preparedness. They complement the ACI World airport traffic statistics and are related to the Korean transit card ridership data.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
